newsitem.title: USA: RTRS-Moody's says Australia re-rating 18 mths away.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moody's says Australia re-rating 18 mths away.

text.p: Australia will probably have to wait about 18 months before Moody's Investors Service considers boosting the country's international credit status, the ratings agency said on Wednesday.
Moody's announced here on Tuesday that the outlook for Australia's Aa2 rating was positive, prompting Treasurer Peter Costello to speculate about a positive re-rating in about six months time.

Moody's senior vice president Yves Lamay told Reuters that changing a rating from stable to positive flagged the possibility of a ratings change to the international financial markets, but it did not necessarily mean a formal review of the situation had been instigated.
"The probability of a (formal) rating review has increased," he said.
"And the usual timing when we put something on a positive outlook is roughly 18 months -- it could come a bit before or a bit later."
